messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

We are very pleased to announce that the 2023 EURING Analytical Conference will take place in Montpellier, France.

Since 1986, this conference has been an important forum for the exchange of information between statisticians and biologists on analytical techniques and their applications. The focus is usually on the development, understanding and integration of statistical methods for estimation and inference on animal population dynamics and demography, with data on marked individuals (via ringing/banding, DNA sequencing, GPS tags, etc). Note that contributions may also deal with unmarked individuals (e.g. occupancy or N-mixture models).

Save the date: The 2023 EURING Analytical Conference will be held on April 17-21, 2023.

Stay tuned for updates regarding a call for abstracts and workshops, registration, and more. Much of the news will be disseminated via the EURING mailing list, which you can join by sending an email to euring-l...@cornell.edu <https://mailto:eur...@cornell.edu> with EURING in the subject, and JOIN in the body. See also the official website http://www.phidot.org/euring/ (thanks to Evan Cooch!).

We look forward to welcoming you all in Montpellier.

Olivier Gimenez & Aurélien Besnard, on behalf of the local organizing committee.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dr Olivier Gimenez | senior scientist at CNRS | @oaggimenez <https://twitter.com/oaggimenez>
olivier...@cefe.cnrs.fr <https://oli...@cefe.cnrs.fr> | https://oliviergimenez.github.io/

Due to my own family/work balance, you may get emails from
me outside of normal working hours. Please do not feel any
pressure to respond outside of your own working pattern.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
